thread:
marta: heads-up — redteam just flagged a service account with overly broad KMS roles in prod (looks like a leftover from a migration). planning a dry-run entitlement sweep in staging tomorrow. want alignment before I kick it off.

devin: ugh. which svcacct? can you paste the evidence?

marta: svc-runner@redwood-prod. evidence from logging: found frequent keyring access + iam.binds around the migration window. snippet:```gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:svc-runner@redwood-prod' --limit 50 --format json```

alina: thanks. redteam severity? is this an active exploit or overly permissive config only?

marta: no signs of malicious use, so far. redteam rated it medium because it's KMS admin on multiple keyrings. risk: key material exposure if that account is compromised.

sam: agree we should be careful. prefer a staged approach: 1) dry-run removal in staging (no actual IAM changes), 2) vet with owners, 3) canary prune in prod off-peak with emergency rollback.

ops-lead: timeline? we have a maintenance window tonight at 0200 UTC, but we shouldn't change prod IAM in that window unless tested. staging dry-run tomorrow 1400 UTC works for me.

marta: plan: run a simulated policy diff using iam-scan tool then produce a playbook for owners. example command I'll run in staging:```python
# iam-scan dry-run
from redwood_iam_scan import Scanner
s = Scanner(project='redwood-staging')
print(s.diff(service_account='svc-runner@redwood-staging'))
```

devin: can infra-bot post the current KMS bindings for svc-runner in staging so owners can review? @infra-bot please.

infra-bot: Automated check queued. Found bindings in staging: roles/cloudkms.admin on keyring "shared-core"; roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on keyring "billing-data". (full output uploaded to /infra/logs/iam-diffs/4087654321.json) :white_check_mark:

alina: owners for "shared-core" are @billing-eng and @data-platform. I'll ping them and schedule a quick 15m review after the dry-run.

marta: proposed rollback & safety: if canary prune causes failures, we have an automatic recreate path and immediate rebind script:```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding key-name \
  --member="serviceAccount:svc-runner@redwood-prod" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.admin"
```this will be pre-tested in staging.

sam: add observability hooks: trace any KMS permission denial spikes in the 30m after changes and auto-roll if >5% error increase. alert to #eng-oncall and pages.

devin: questions about audit logs — how far back do we need to keep logs for this review and potential forensic work? we currently have 90 days in stackdriver.

alina: for KMS-related entitlements we prefer 180 days if possible. product-security will open a request to extend retention for the keyring audit logs tied to sensitive projects.

marta: action items: 1) I run staging dry-run and upload iam diff (marta) 2) infra-bot posts full binding dump (infra-bot) 3) owners review and ack (billing-eng, data-platform) 4) observability rule ready (sam) 5) retention request (alina). I'll start the dry-run at 1400 UTC tomorrow and post results.

devin: please include the exact grep for mapping service accounts to keypaths in the upload so we can quickly identify collateral effects.

marta: will do. small sample grep included in report:```bash
jq '.bindings[] | select(.members[]? | contains("svc-runner@"))' iam-dump.json
```

ops-lead: FYI if any prod change is needed we require a 24h owner ack + runbook in the ticket. don't skip that.

marta: acknowledged. tagging the runbook template in the ticket and will add rollback steps. thanks all. :thumbsup:

alina: +1. ping me if owners push back; we'll coordinate escalation.

sam: sound plan. I'll prep the alert thresholds and docs for oncall.

infra-bot: Dry-run completed in staging at 1402 UTC. Generated diff: svc-runner loses roles/cloudkms.admin on keyring "shared-core" and roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on "billing-data" (no runtime errors observed in staging during 30m observe window). Report: /infra/logs/iam-diffs/4087654321-dryrun.json

marta: uploading report now and pinging owners.

devin: nice. once owners ack, let's schedule a low-risk prod canary (single keyring) and validate for 1h before wider rollout.

marta: owners acked for shared-core (billing-eng) and billing-data (data-platform). booking prod canary for 0300 UTC tomorrow low-traffic window.

ops-lead: ensure you open a post-change ticket summarizing outcomes and include any anomalies.

marta: will do. closing this thread for now — will update after prod canary.
